The University of Idaho Moscow campus offers many free services to students. The tables
below list the contact information for each office for the **2026--27** academic year.
If you are not sure where to start, ask me and I will help you find the right office.

## VandalCARE

If you are concerned about a fellow Vandal (student, staff, or faculty), submit a
VandalCARE referral by visiting the
[VandalCARE website](https://www.uidaho.edu/student-affairs/dean-of-students/vandalcare)
or by scanning the QR code below.

<img src="images/QR-code-vandalcare.png" alt="QR code linking to the VandalCARE referral form" style="width: 200px; max-width: 100%;">

**If you consider the situation you are reporting an emergency, call 911 immediately.**
